content:
Agreed 2026-09-03. Build order is fixed:

Phase 1 — the standalone task store in memory-mcp. Schema v5 (tasks, task_comments, task_time_entries in per-project DuckDB), repository + service + MCP tools + Tasks tab in the React UI + session brief integration. Must work with ZERO asoode. Prompt: docs/bridge/05-session-prompt.md.

Phase 2 — the optional asoode bridge. Outbox out, live Socket.IO in from a new asyncio task in daemon.build_app()'s lifespan. Gated on asoode's P0 items landing (externalRef + unique index, socket auth via shared credential verification, recipient targeting fix, non-expiring machine tokens). Asoode backlog: asoode/docs/claude-bridge-backlog.md, prompt: asoode/docs/claude-bridge-prompt.md.

Phase 3 — a standing agent team: pm, design, frontend, backend, e2e. Doc: docs/bridge/06-agent-team.md.

WHY the agent team is last, not first: subagents are stateless per invocation and share no conversation — each gets a prompt, not the transcript. A team built before Phase 1 would be five agents that forget everything between invocations and re-derive the same conclusions in parallel. The dependency is durable shared state: memory MCP for what outlives a task, task comments for handoffs. The five agent definition files themselves are about an hour of work; the state they need is the actual project.

Key facts recorded for Phase 3: subagents inherit the session's MCP servers (so every agent can call memory_* and asoode tools); isolation: worktree lets frontend and backend work the same repo in parallel; seven design skills already installed at ~/.claude/skills/; the main session must be the orchestrator, not a pm agent, because nesting loses information at every hop and subagent output is never shown to the user directly.
summary: Three-phase sequence: task module, then asoode bridge, then agent team: Agreed 2026-09-03
title: Three-phase sequence: task module, then asoode bridge, then agent team
